name: redeemid/account-status
title: Shopify Account Status
description: Tells the visitor where they stand: signed in or not, linked to a Shopify customer, when their membership last synced, and whether Shopify sign-in is available. A Blockstudio dynamic island: the cached page carries a neutral placeholder and each visitor's own fragment fills it in.

attributes.label: Show the raw status response (nonces redacted), for troubleshooting
